faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP ProBook 430 G4, 440 G4, 450 G4, 455 G4 and 470 G4. The part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is this an original or compatible battery?
faqs.answer: This is a genuine original HP RR03XL unit. We also stock a lower-cost compatible/generic version of this battery — ask us on WhatsApp if you'd like pricing for that instead.
